hero.title: The homes our family built
hero.subtitle: Every property here was built by our family, across Westchester County. Some have been sold, some are lovingly rented, and a few are still waiting for the right family. This is their story, and ours.

story.title: Built by hand, generation to generation
story.founder_line: Built by a family of Licensed Builders
story.image_alt: Inside a home built by the Giaccio family
body: Giaccio Properties was founded on one belief: a home should be built to last, and built to be lived in. Every property in this collection was raised by hand by our family, right here in Westchester County, with the same care we would give our own.
Over the years many of these homes have found their families and moved on. Others are rented and full of life today. And a few are still here, waiting for the right people to walk through the door.
Together they are more than listings. They are two generations of a family's life's work, and we are proud to share them with you.

about.title: A legacy you can walk through
body: Giaccio Properties is a family portfolio of homes built across Westchester County, New York, from Bedford and Pound Ridge to South Salem, Katonah, and beyond.

What started as one family building homes with their own hands has grown into a collection of properties, some sold to the families who now love them, some rented and lived in today, and some still available for the right owner.

We know every one of these homes because we built them. When you reach out, you are talking to the family behind them, not a call center. Whether you want to buy, rent, or simply hear the story of a house, we are here.
about.founder_note: Giaccio Properties is a family business run by Rich Giaccio, a Westchester entrepreneur and business owner. Every home in this collection was built by hand by our family's licensed builders.

contact.intro: Tell us what you're looking for, or ask about any home in the collection. We read every message personally.
